units: <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 26:1">Pesik. R. s. 26</cite> <he>היה גוֹחֵן לארץ וכ׳</he> he bent down to the ground and kissed the foot-prints.
Num. R. s. 4, beg. אמו גוֹחֶנֶת עליו וכ׳ his mother bends over him and lets him suck; (Tosef. Sabb. XV (XVI), 5 שוחה).—Part. pass. גָּחוּן bent.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 20">Gen. R. s. 20</cite> <he>שיהו מהלכין גְּחוּנִין וכ׳</he> (v.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 31">Yalk. ib. 31</cite>) that they walk bent (with grief) over their dead.
